class_table_source: OPERA DSWx-HLS Product Specification v1.0.1, JPL D-107395 Rev B, 2024-07-10, Table 4-1
class_note: counts are raw class values over the cells whose centre is inside the polygon; pixels_in_polygon is their total, so a valid fraction is computed from the classes and never from the raster's padding. The two DSWx products use the same integers for different classes, so the meaning comes from the product's own table and never from the value

grid.note: one mosaic per acquisition date; overlapping MGRS tiles are written once
